chunks: And in the alternation of night and day, and in what Allah sends from the sky of provision, whereby He revives the earth after its death, and in the shifting of the winds, are signs for a people who use reason.

key_terms.لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ: for a people who use reason

ai.seo_question: What natural signs in the Quran indicate God's power for people of understanding?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to demonstrate the unity of God through the diversity of natural phenomena, linking the physical resurrection of the earth to the spiritual resurrection of the soul. The mention of 'sustenance' (rizq) sent from the sky underscores God's providential care, while the call to 'those who understand' (li-qawmin ya'qilun) highlights the intellectual capacity required to discern divine wisdom in creation.
